name: Troll Temper
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak make a tempering agent from sandstones, and I can use that to temper the goods I craft, yes I can!  It is highly prized by connoisseurs, so if you bring me a good supply of the temper, then I'll reward you well.

Zul'Farrak is northwest of Gadgetzan.  Good luck.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, this is very nice temper indeed! And so much of it! I'll be at work for days before I use it all!

Thank you, adventurer. Please, take this as payment.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you bring me the temper, adventurer?
